groups.defect: The postMessage origin check in embed.js uses a substring test (indexOf) rather than an exact origin match, so prefix or lookalike origins are accepted.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same line in embed.js and report the same weak origin check, with the same fix.

groups.defect: Stored XSS: the embed URL is put into the 'imported from' link without escaping, and imported raw_html content is stored and rendered without sanitization because cook returns raw unchanged.
groups.rationale: s_bfc86ebc and s_8ac429ca both report the unescaped URL. s_8ac429ca and s_8882a392 both report that raw HTML is rendered unsanitized and creates an XSS sink. That chain links all three.

groups.defect: embed.post can be nil when the post was deleted, so PostRevisor.new(nil).revise! raises and aborts the whole feed poll.
groups.rationale: Same nil-post defect in the same lines of TopicEmbed.import, with the same fix.

groups.defect: i.content is nil for RSS 2.0 items, so i.content.scrub raises NoMethodError and aborts the import. String#scrub is also unavailable on Ruby 2.0, which CI uses.
groups.rationale: Both report the nil-content crash at the same line. s_3abf3cfd adds the Ruby-version problem with scrub, so the merged comment has to cover both.
